title: Box Posts Stronger-Than-Expected Revenue But Stock Wavers Late After Recent Rally
summary: Box stock wavered in late trading Tuesday, after the enterprise software company reported second-quarter earnings results. Redwood City, Calif.-based Box earned an adjusted 40 cents per share for the July-ended quarter, up 21% from a year earlier. Founded in 2005, Box offers enterprise file and content-sharing tools it says are utilized by more than two-thirds of Fortune 500 companies.
